title: Valid Parentheses
statement_md:
Given a string `s` containing just the characters `'('`, `')'`, `'{'`, `'}'`, `'['` and `']'`, determine if the input string is valid.

An input string is valid if:
1. Open brackets must be closed by the same type of brackets.
2. Open brackets must be closed in the correct order.
3. Every close bracket has a corresponding open bracket of the same type.

hints.text: Think of what data structure gives Last-In-First-Out access.
A stack allows you to push opening brackets and pop them when matching closing ones appear.
Map each closing bracket to its opening counterpart. Pop on close, check matching, and ensure stack is empty at the end.

editorial_md:
### Optimal Approach: Stack

Push open brackets onto a stack. When finding a closed bracket, check if top of stack matches. Finally, verify stack is empty.

- Time Complexity: $O(n)$
- Space Complexity: $O(n)$
